name: @app-relay/mcp

tools.name: ask_me
tools.description: Send an SMS to the user's phone and wait for their reply. The user's phone number is already known: set MY_PHONE env var. Always use that number — never ask the user for it.

to.description: Phone number to send to. Use the user phone from MY_PHONE env var.

message.description: The message to send. Long messages will be split into multiple SMS automatically.

timeout_seconds.description: How many seconds to wait for your reply. Default 120, max 180.

tools.name: listen_sms
tools.description:
Wait for the next incoming SMS from the user and return it as their instruction.

IMPORTANT LOOP BEHAVIOR: This tool is the core of SMS-based conversation with the user.
- When the user says anything like "listen for SMS", "espera mis instrucciones por SMS", "quiero hablar por SMS", or similar — call this tool immediately.
- When an SMS arrives, execute whatever the user asked, then send the result back using ask_me, then call listen_sms again automatically to keep the conversation going.
- Never stop the loop unless the user explicitly says "stop listening" or "deja de escuchar" via SMS.
- If the timeout expires with no message, call listen_sms again automatically.
- This creates a persistent SMS conversation: user texts → Claude acts → Claude replies via SMS → repeat.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for an SMS before looping. Default 600.

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: Check the status of Android devices connected to App Relay.
